description: P35-train SIDER liability labels per docs/prereg-p35-go.md, built by scripts/p35_2_build.py with sider_labels.build_train_labels.

rule.positive: a mapped PT with placebo-adjusted frequency_upper >= 0.01
rule.aggregation: per drug x PT: max non-placebo upper minus max placebo upper

split_rule: held-out iff int(sha256(inn.strip().lower()), 16) % 10 in {0, 1}; not stored
